newsitem.title: USA: Two investors buy stakes in Dow Jones --NYT.
newsitem.headline: Two investors buy stakes in Dow Jones --NYT.

text.p: Two investors acting separately have acquired large interests in Dow Jones & Co, the New York Times reported on Wednesday.
The investors are James Cramer, the manager of a private investment fund who holds a little more than one million shares, and Michael Price, who now owns 4.5 million shares, the paper said.

The report said based on Dow Jones' 96 million outstanding shares, Cramer has a one percent interest and Price has a 4.7 percent interest. According to the paper, Price is known for successfully forcing companies to improve their stock prices.
Dow Jones shares fell after the company announced last week a multimillion dollar plan to overhaul its electronic financial information service.
The company closed down 7/8 at 35-1/2 Tuesday.
